integrity: The proof is self-contained after the standard Hankel and normalized-kernel identities. Finite rank gives compactness and finite-dimensional range for H*H; norm saturation forces a kernel to be a top eigenvector; this forces the origin; the resulting coefficient autocorrelations admit only singleton support. No numerical computation is used.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only nonzero analytic polynomial symbols vanishing at the origin. It does not classify nonpolynomial bounded or BMOA symbols and does not settle the source's questions about intermediate equality below the supremum norm or unbounded symbols. An older equivalent finite-rank observation under different terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Monomial rigidity for polynomial-symbol Hankel operators obeying the strong reproducing kernel thesis
